bomba-rose.inspired_by: Mawar bomba, the rose of the Donggala buya bomba sarong (Kaili people, Central Sulawesi), drawn from above with one stem and three leaves.
bomba-rose.made_our_own: Petal rings in Fibonacci counts (13·8·5·3) turned by the golden angle; two-tone brushed petals with cecek veins; a golden-spiral heart; Bali teal and navy leaves.
bomba-rose.meaning_honoured: In the buya bomba tradition the rose speaks of pure love for family, kingdom and God.

bomba-rosette.inspired_by: The same mawar bomba, as the open flower that gives Bomba its name ('bomba' is Kaili for flower).
bomba-rosette.made_our_own: Five Fibonacci petal rings (21·13·8·5·3): a pure phyllotaxis flower that tiles as a placement or a repeat.
bomba-rosette.meaning_honoured: Openness and togetherness, the meanings Palu people give the name Bomba.

rebung-border.inspired_by: Rebung (bamboo-shoot) borders of buya bomba, pointing inward, with the zigzag and dotted framing bands.
rebung-border.made_our_own: Two facing rows meeting at a gold zigzag spine with pearl cecek; sheaths drawn as nested chevrons; seamless horizontally.
rebung-border.meaning_honoured: In the cloth's iconography, inward-facing rebung stand for power, greatness and triumph.

ketupat-lattice.inspired_by: Belah ketupat (diamond) patterns in the head panel of buya bomba, known in Bugis as cobo'.
ketupat-lattice.made_our_own: A seamless three-tone nested-diamond lattice with pearl cecek crosses at the joins.
ketupat-lattice.meaning_honoured: Courage in proposing marriage and the wisdom of rulers and elders.

cengkeh-sprig.inspired_by: Cengkeh (clove) motifs of Palu batik, honouring Tolitoli's clove harvest.
cengkeh-sprig.made_our_own: A fan of five clove buds (a Fibonacci number) on curving stalks with one navy and one teal leaf.
cengkeh-sprig.meaning_honoured: Healing and wishes for the wearer's health and well-being.

dua-pulau-medallion.inspired_by: The meeting of two islands: Bomba's rose and rebung from Central Sulawesi, with the lotus-petal and keyline language of the Balinese master motifs.
dua-pulau-medallion.made_our_own: Our emblem: a Bomba rose heart, 13 rebung rays, a ring of 55 cecek dots and 21 outer leaves. Every count is a Fibonacci number.
dua-pulau-medallion.meaning_honoured: Recognition of both origins in one mark.

isen-cecek.inspired_by: Cecek, the dotted isen-isen fill of hand-drawn batik made with the canting, and the dotted framing bands of buya bomba.
isen-cecek.made_our_own: A gently jittered staggered dot field that wraps seamlessly.

isen-zigzag.inspired_by: The zigzag lines that frame the central field of buya bomba.
isen-zigzag.made_our_own: Rows of zigzag with a periodic hand tremor, seamless in both directions.
isen-zigzag.meaning_honoured: The cloth's own framing language, used as texture.

isen-sero.inspired_by: Sero tangga, the Palu batik motif of the coastal fish trap, and sawut line fills.
isen-sero.made_our_own: Alternating blocks of fine parallel strokes, like woven trap panels.
isen-sero.meaning_honoured: Hard work that pays off; the lives of coastal fishing communities.

rebung-ribbon.inspired_by: The same inward-facing rebung borders of the Donggala buya bomba, whose framing bands run unbroken along the cloth.
rebung-ribbon.made_our_own: A ribbon that is drawn live along any path, straight, diagonal, wave, golden spiral or golden arcs, with every shoot bending to the curve, rows offset by half a step, and a zigzag cecek spine. It skips curves too tight for the band rather than crumpling.
rebung-ribbon.meaning_honoured: Power, greatness and triumph, now flowing with the pattern.
